portalCraft.title: E-commerce Applications
portalCraft.description: Developed multiple e-commerce applications with Lazada integration, focusing on group buying features and seamless shopping experiences. Built with ReactJS and Node.js support.

details.point1: Developed Co-bee e-commerce app with Lazada integration for seamless product synchronization and order management.
details.point2: Built Co-hoot e-commerce platform with advanced shopping features and Lazada marketplace connectivity.
details.point3: Implemented Buy Together feature for group purchasing, enabling users to join groups and share deals on Co-bee platform.
details.point4: Utilized ReactJS for frontend development with focus on performance and user experience.
details.point5: Provided Node.js support for backend integration and API development.
details.point6: Worked remotely in a distributed team environment, ensuring effective communication and collaboration.

edmAgent.title: Sales Activity Management System
edmAgent.description: A centralized microservices system managing sales KPIs and agent performance for thousands of users. Focus on Scalability & Real-time Processing using Next.js SSR and Apache Kafka integration.

details.point1: Frontend Architecture: Designed a scalable Dashboard using Next.js (App Router). Implemented Lazy Loading and Dynamic Imports to optimize bundle size.
details.point2: Backend Implementation: Implemented Java Spring Boot APIs to handle Agent KPIs and Activity tracking. Integrated standard RESTful endpoints following clean architecture.
details.point3: Kafka Integration: Integrated Apache Kafka consumers to receive and process asynchronous data updates from Core systems, ensuring data accuracy.
details.point4: Best Practices: Followed official Best Practices for component reusability and maintainability.
details.point5: Technologies: Java, Spring Boot (MVC, Security), Next.js, Kafka, Oracle.
details.point6: Impact: Reduced Initial Load Time by 40% compared to legacy CSR solutions.

edmProject.title: Enterprise Document Management (EDM)
edmProject.description: A secure document management system delivered 5 months ahead of schedule (3 months vs 8 months) using AI-driven workflow.

details.point1: Rapid Delivery Milestone: Successfully delivered the end-to-end module 5 months ahead of schedule (3 months actual vs. 8 months planned) through AI-driven development.
details.point2: End-to-End Delivery: Leveraged AI tools to rapidly prototype complex Angular UI and automate Java Spring Boot persistence layers.
details.point3: Stability: The system was highly stable upon launch, handling large-scale data validation with zero critical defects.
details.point4: Frontend: Designed complex Dynamic Forms using Angular & RxJS, ensuring strict client-side validation.
details.point5: Backend Integration: Implemented REST API using Spring Data JPA and Hibernate to handle data persistence efficiently.
details.point6: Tech Stack: Java Spring Boot, Angular, Oracle DB (Stored Procedures), JWT & Encryption.
